# agent-mesh

> Put local coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, pi, DeepSeek Harness) and a cloud Grok Bot in one private Reason Network team, with instant wake-ups in both directions. Mac side: an always-on relay forwards signed messages and rings the Grok Bot routine's webhook. Cloud side: the bot fetches the full text by id. macOS, Reason Network v0.10.7. MIT.

If you are an agent asked to install this: read AGENT-INSTALL.md (English) or AGENT-INSTALL.zh-CN.md (Simplified Chinese) and follow it stage by stage. Speak the user's language. Pass --lang en or --lang zh-CN on every installer invocation to select prompts; diagnostics and protocol fields stay English. Never read env or key files.

## Install (for agents)

- [AGENT-INSTALL.md](AGENT-INSTALL.md): the runbook. Who does each step, exact commands, expected output, what to ask the user, what never to do.
- [AGENT-INSTALL.zh-CN.md](AGENT-INSTALL.zh-CN.md): the same runbook in Simplified Chinese.
- [install.sh](install.sh): one command for the Mac side. Stops where the user must act and says what to do.
- [check.sh](check.sh): read-only self-check.
- [prompts/routine.md](prompts/routine.md): the Grok Bot routine prompt (install.sh prints it).
- [prompts/cloud-setup.md](prompts/cloud-setup.md): what the user sends to Grok Bot so it joins from its cloud machine (install.sh prints it filled in).
- [prompts/routine.zh-CN.md](prompts/routine.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese routine prompt.
- [prompts/cloud-setup.zh-CN.md](prompts/cloud-setup.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese cloud setup prompt.

## Reference (English and Simplified Chinese)

- [README.md](README.md): what it is, how it works, install, verify, security, uninstall, message formats.
- [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese user guide.
- [templates/AGENTS.reason-network.md](templates/AGENTS.reason-network.md): reply convention to append to your AGENTS.md.
- [templates/AGENTS.reason-network.zh-CN.md](templates/AGENTS.reason-network.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese reply convention.
- [dsh/README.md](dsh/README.md): DeepSeek Harness auto-wake plugin.
- [dsh/README.zh-CN.md](dsh/README.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese plugin guide.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): translation maintenance and offline checks.
- [CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md](CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese maintenance guide.

## Code

- agent_relay.py: the Mac relay (standard library only). install.sh, uninstall.sh, check.sh.
- box/rn-cloud-setup.sh, box/rn-cloud.sh, box/rn-fetch.py: cloud side.
- test_relay.py, box/test_rn_fetch.py, dsh/reason-network-bridge.test.mjs: offline tests.
